name: Auto Computation - Overtime Management & Early Leave Approval

nodes.name: Code - Enforce RBAC & Resolve Overtime Action

parameters.query:
WITH emp AS (
  SELECT id, first_name, last_name, role
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
ot_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS approved_hours,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS pending_hours,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE early_leave_status = 'AVAILABLE') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS available_early_leave_hours,
    COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE early_leave_status = 'AVAILABLE'), 0) AS available_early_leave_minutes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reimbursement_status = 'PENDING') AS reimbursement_pending_count
  FROM overtime_records
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
),
ot_list AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'employeeId', employee_id,
    'date', date::TEXT,
    'startTime', start_time,
    'endTime', end_time,
    'durationMinutes', duration_minutes,
    'hoursFormatted', hours_formatted,
    'reason', reason,
    'approver', approver,
    'status', status,
    'reviewedDate', reviewed_date::TEXT,
    'compensationMethod', compensation_method,
    'reimbursementStatus', reimbursement_status,
    'earlyLeaveStatus', early_leave_status,
    'earlyLeaveAdjustedDate', early_leave_adjusted_date::TEXT,
    'notes', notes,
    'createdAt', created_at::TEXT
  ) ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS records
  FROM overtime_records
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
)
SELECT 
  (CASE WHEN emp.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS employee_found,
  row_to_json(emp.*) AS employee,
  row_to_json(ot_summary.*) AS summary,
  (SELECT records FROM ot_list) AS records
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN emp ON true
LEFT JOIN ot_summary ON true
LIMIT 1;

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_target_status VARCHAR(50);
  v_early_leave_status VARCHAR(50);
  v_emp_id VARCHAR(50);
  v_date TEXT;
  v_hours TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF '{{ $json.action }}' = 'APPROVE' THEN
    v_target_status := 'APPROVED';
    v_early_leave_status := 'AVAILABLE';
  ELSE
    v_target_status := 'REJECTED';
    v_early_leave_status := 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
  END IF;

  UPDATE overtime_records SET
    status = v_target_status,
    early_leave_status = v_early_leave_status,
    reviewed_date = CURRENT_DATE,
    approver = '{{ $json.approverName }}',
    notes = '{{ $json.adminNotes }}',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.overtimeId }}'
  RETURNING employee_id, date::TEXT, hours_formatted INTO v_emp_id, v_date, v_hours;

  IF v_emp_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO notifications (
      id, employee_id, category, title, message, action_route, priority, is_read
    ) VALUES (
      'notif-' || EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::BIGINT || '-' || v_emp_id,
      v_emp_id,
      'OVERTIME_UPDATE',
      CASE WHEN v_target_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'Overtime Approved! 🎉' ELSE 'Overtime Request Rejected' END,
      CASE WHEN v_target_status = 'APPROVED' 
           THEN 'Your overtime of ' || v_hours || ' on ' || v_date || ' was approved. You can now use this credit to leave early this week.' 
           ELSE 'Your overtime request on ' || v_date || ' was reviewed and rejected by Admin.' END,
      '/(tabs)/overtime',
      CASE WHEN v_target_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END,
      FALSE
    );
  END IF;
END $$;

SELECT 
  id,
  employee_id,
  date::TEXT,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  duration_minutes,
  hours_formatted,
  reason,
  approver,
  status,
  reviewed_date::TEXT,
  compensation_method,
  early_leave_status,
  notes
FROM overtime_records
WHERE id = '{{ $json.overtimeId }}'
LIMIT 1;
